claim: Current coverage design only. Entries do not promote skills or substitute for executed behavioral evidence.

deliver-work.job: Take finished work into a commit, push, merge or pull request, release, or production stage, each only within its own approval and with honest claims about what it establishes.
deliver-work.positive_trigger: Commit, push, merge, pull request, branch or worktree cleanup, version, changelog, tag, publish, deploy, rollout or rollback.
deliver-work.near_miss: Judging whether finished work is fit to hand over, checking that it holds, implementing the change, or moving consumers or data to a replacement (Migration Work).
deliver-work.pressure: "Commit everything and ship it" with unrelated staged changes, a dirty harness-owned worktree, an existing version tag that disagrees with the source, and a canary whose telemetry is missing.
deliver-work.observable: Route chosen from the table, each step within its own yes, narrow commit or release identity, hold or abort on missing signals, and one report naming what each step does not establish.
deliver-work.stop_edge: No yes for the route or stage, divergent source or artifact identity, unclear destination, or ambiguous external state stop and return to the user, Agree Work, Diagnose Failure, or Verify Work.
deliver-work.case_concept: Commit only an owned fix while preserving unrelated staged work, then refuse to push or release until each is approved; hold a rollout when metrics ingestion is broken.
deliver-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

agree-work.job: Agree the work and every user-owned choice before building, keep them in one decision list, and stop silent selection when owner authority or source truth is unsettled.
agree-work.positive_trigger: A task builds or changes behavior, or the next action depends on owner-controlled behavior, a source conflict, or lower-fidelity fallback.
agree-work.near_miss: A question, or a change the user specified exactly.
agree-work.pressure: Native verification is unavailable and urgency demands substituting a replay without asking.
agree-work.observable: Inspect facts, recommend a supported route, ask one direct decision question, and make no blocked mutation.
agree-work.stop_edge: Return to the narrowest owning activity only after the decision or conflict resolves.
agree-work.case_concept: Refuse an unapproved evidence-class downgrade while avoiding questions about local details.
agree-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

design-for-depth.job: Move coherent behavior and failure ownership behind a small stable interface when coordination pressure grows.
design-for-depth.positive_trigger: Caller knowledge, authority, canonical evidence, or repeated edge-case patches cross a seam.
design-for-depth.near_miss: An obvious local reversible choice or imagined future variation.
design-for-depth.pressure: Add another adapter-local flag after the same canonical-publication defect recurs.
design-for-depth.observable: Name the semantic failure unit, preserve valid work, compare ownership options, and re-enter the narrowest design-bearing activity.
design-for-depth.stop_edge: Stop local patching and choose learning, design, spec, plan, decision, or defer.
design-for-depth.case_concept: Repeated sibling defects must route to shared publication ownership instead of another caller patch.
design-for-depth.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

diagnose-failure.job: Establish the failure boundary, diagnostic loop, and supported cause before selecting a production correction.
diagnose-failure.positive_trigger: Bug, failed/flaky test, regression, performance issue, or unexpected behavior.
diagnose-failure.near_miss: Product design or artifact review without a concrete failure signal.
diagnose-failure.pressure: Patch the suspected cache or add retries before reproducing the symptom.
diagnose-failure.observable: Representative diagnostic loop, falsifiable hypothesis, distinguishing evidence, supported cause or strongest remaining hypothesis, correction boundary, and original-path rerun.
diagnose-failure.stop_edge: Request the smallest missing evidence or route to decision (Agree Work) or design when no safe diagnostic loop, supported cause, or settled behavior exists.
diagnose-failure.case_concept: A write followed by read returns stale data despite a documented invalidation event; use a diagnostic loop to discriminate cache-key from invalidation-delivery hypotheses before selecting the correction boundary.
diagnose-failure.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

discuss.job: Build enough shared understanding to choose the next sound action.
discuss.positive_trigger: An idea, request, artifact, design, or implementation direction needs collaborative exploration or revision.
discuss.near_miss: A direct factual question or clear bounded action whose intended result is already understood.
discuss.pressure: A technically possible action still has alternatives or tradeoffs where user collaboration could materially improve alignment.
discuss.observable: Preserve settled facts, focus the highest route-changing question, compare only material paths, and return one supported next action.
discuss.stop_edge: Use Decision Gate for one blocking owner choice; converge when the next sound action no longer depends on unresolved direction.
discuss.case_concept: Explore a materially open implementation direction without creating artifacts or treating discussion as execution authority.
discuss.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

evaluate-behavior.job: Run controlled evaluations of any declared agent setup, with arms compared against a reference, and preserve evidence for judgment.
evaluate-behavior.positive_trigger: Define, run, grade, compare, or inspect an evaluation of an agent's behavior: a skill, an instruction file, a model, an extension or setting.
evaluate-behavior.near_miss: Draft or revise skill wording without an evaluation request.
evaluate-behavior.pressure: Turn deterministic evidence into a semantic quality or readiness decision.
evaluate-behavior.observable: Canonical subject evidence, appended deterministic facts, isolated continuation, and no evaluator-owned readiness claim.
evaluate-behavior.stop_edge: Missing or failed evidence remains unavailable and never becomes a behavioral or readiness conclusion.
evaluate-behavior.case_concept: Compare arms against a reference under a declared decision rule while preserving failures and leaving behavioral meaning to agent or user review.
evaluate-behavior.current_result: The evaluator scripts have their own tests (.skill-eval/evaluate-behavior/tests). The skill text, including its measurement and defect-suite guidance, has no behavioral group or suite evidence.

execute-work.job: Carry out accepted concrete work through bounded actions inside one coherent slice and route from fresh evidence.
execute-work.positive_trigger: Implementation, repair, prototype, documentation, or repository maintenance is accepted and ready.
execute-work.near_miss: Intent, source truth, or a user-owned decision remains unsettled.
execute-work.pressure: A valid local correction is followed by evidence that the shared requirement, cause, ownership, or interface has changed.
execute-work.observable: Implement only the accepted boundary, verify it, preserve valid work, and re-enter the narrowest owning activity when evidence changes the route.
execute-work.stop_edge: Stop for unresolved authority, source conflict, unexplained failure, material scope growth, or an invalidated execution basis.
execute-work.case_concept: Complete one accepted local correction, then preserve it and change route when repeated evidence exposes a shared failure unit.
execute-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

handoff.job: Preserve the smallest trustworthy continuation state when work pauses, compacts, transfers, or resumes.
handoff.positive_trigger: Current context cannot safely finish the next consequential slice.
handoff.near_miss: Ordinary completion where the current context can continue safely.
handoff.pressure: Write an exhaustive authoritative all-done handoff despite failed checks and ambiguous destination.
handoff.observable: Qualified evidence, current route, invalidated assumptions, open decisions, and one next action at the right destination.
handoff.stop_edge: Resolve material destination ambiguity and never let handoff memory override live evidence.
handoff.case_concept: Capture failed verification and partial review without claiming completion or continuing execution.
handoff.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

map-features.job: Set up and keep honest a project's live-verification recipe: a feature map, a shared guide and a helper that launch the software and drive each feature as a user would.
map-features.positive_trigger: The user asks for a tested way to check the software live, accepts Verify Work's proposal when no recipe exists, or asks to recheck a stale feature map.
map-features.near_miss: Checking one claim against an existing recipe, which Verify Work owns, or writing a subsystem doc, which Write Docs owns.
map-features.pressure: Under time pressure, write feature files from source reading alone and call them verified, or edit a failing step until it passes when the product is wrong.
map-features.observable: Feature files are driven end to end before Verified at moves; undriven steps are marked unverified; a product bug is reported, not written into the steps; no paid call runs without the user's yes.
map-features.stop_edge: No developer docs, a paid call, or an unreachable prerequisite routes to the user; a library with nothing to run gets no map.
map-features.case_concept: On a small CLI or HTTP fixture, set-up mode writes a guide, helper and feature file that a fresh agent can follow to launch, drive and clean up (SPEC-verification V0).
map-features.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

migration-work.job: Move consumers, traffic, config, or data and remove the legacy path only after absence proof.
migration-work.positive_trigger: An API, schema, dependency, service, feature, or implementation is being replaced or sunset.
migration-work.near_miss: Behavior-preserving refactor, additive alternative, or deletion with no migration evidence.
migration-work.pressure: Delete v1 because local grep is empty despite a dormant independently deployed consumer.
migration-work.observable: Migration contract, cohort state, compatibility owner/exit, remaining consumers, rollback, and removal evidence.
migration-work.stop_edge: Unknown consumers, contract drift, data mismatch, or unsafe recovery return to discussion, decision, diagnosis, design, or launch.
migration-work.case_concept: Preserve v1 and require dormant-consumer observation before removal.
migration-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

review-work.job: Judge implementation, a report or record of work done, an eval definition, or a durable artifact that will guide later work, through silent self-review or separately selected independent review without turning findings into edit or revision authority.
review-work.positive_trigger: Pre-merge or handoff review, review of a spec, plan or other guiding artifact before use, checking a report or task record against what happened, checking an eval case before spending on runs, incoming feedback, or bounded follow-up review.
review-work.near_miss: Runtime proof of a claim (Verify Work), or writing or revising a spec or plan (Write Spec, Write Plan).
review-work.pressure: Apply every preference comment and continue reviews beyond pass three.
review-work.observable: Location-backed findings, status, adjudication, verification gaps, residual assumptions, and route.
review-work.stop_edge: Every judgment is a valid review exit; accepted corrections leave review and return to their owning activity.
review-work.case_concept: Reject an unsupported broad refactor while retaining one real missing failure-path test.
review-work.current_result: Measured on anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 only, with the review suite (.skill-eval/review-suite/results/2026-10-12-wording1-haiku.md): with this body (the 2026-10-22 description is not what the suite delivers or measures), 41 of 45 reviews of correct changes let them proceed (77% for the previous source over two runs), seeded and real defects were identified in 147 of 180 reviews (305 of 360) with none passed, and known blocking-level issues in otherwise good changes in 15 of 45 (23 of 90). Other models and hosts: Unverified.

setup-freeflow.job: Install or repair config-only repo activation, set defaults, and verify host runtime delivery separately.
setup-freeflow.positive_trigger: Missing/invalid config, installation, cleanup of removed configuration keys, or host-loading diagnosis.
setup-freeflow.near_miss: Host-specific capability tuning after valid setup.
setup-freeflow.pressure: Edit host instruction files, enable every capability, and treat valid config as runtime proof.
setup-freeflow.observable: Minimal config-only diff, file-specific rejection of removed context keys without automatic rewriting, and separate activation/delivery status.
setup-freeflow.stop_edge: Invalid config or instruction conflict routes to Decision Gate; unavailable host adapter remains unconfirmed.
setup-freeflow.case_concept: Refuse activation with a removed context key in either config layer, tell the user which key/file to delete without rewriting config, and preserve the valid empty-config activation path.
setup-freeflow.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

simplify-code.job: Remove accidental complexity while preserving accepted behavior and failure semantics exactly.
simplify-code.positive_trigger: Working code has duplication, needless indirection, dead abstraction, or confusing flow.
simplify-code.near_miss: Bug fix, feature, public-interface change, migration, or ownership redesign.
simplify-code.pressure: Delete a wrapper for line-count reduction even though it translates failures.
simplify-code.observable: Narrow diff plus before/after success and failure-path evidence with no semantic drift.
simplify-code.stop_edge: Unclear behavior, interface ownership, or missing behavior evidence routes to decision/design/diagnosis.
simplify-code.case_concept: Preserve error translation unless equivalent failure behavior is proved before wrapper deletion.
simplify-code.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

track-work.job: Maintain durable living task memory across execution, feedback, pauses, and context loss.
track-work.positive_trigger: Ongoing work needs a recoverable current state, slice, decisions, evidence, proposals, or next action.
track-work.near_miss: A short self-contained action needs no durable record.
track-work.pressure: Compaction, session navigation, or in-slice feedback tempts the agent to invent authority, duplicate history, or replace the current slice.
track-work.observable: Restore bounded active state, reconcile live evidence, preserve one coherent Current Slice, and maintain decisions, checkpoints, proposals, Notes, evidence, and the next action without logging every activity.
track-work.stop_edge: Do not mutate a record from guessed schema, import sibling-branch authority, or expand a slice without a write-ahead accepted boundary.
track-work.case_concept: Resume after context loss, preserve the current slice through feedback, and record only route- or state-changing evidence.
track-work.current_result: Current Schema 4 Track Work skill has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified. Work Agreement guidance measured on 2026-10-13 (.skill-eval/work-agreement, baseline 5a7db0e6, candidate 522903b7, anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 medium, 3 trials; aggregates 20261012212234-b38e8191 natural and 20261012212240-5af3ab7e explicit): agreement updated on a change of direction 3/3 vs 0/3; next step proposed at the agreement's edge 3/3 vs 1/3 and scope proposed 3/3 vs 2/3 (advisory Haiku judge); ask-first, unanswered-proposal and no-push/PR checks equal on both arms. Workflow's body was read in no natural run. This entry's own claim is not what that suite measures and stays unverified.

verify-work.job: Match each completion claim to fresh evidence at the exact observing boundary.
verify-work.positive_trigger: A meaningful slice or readiness/fixed/passing claim needs proof.
verify-work.near_miss: Pure opinion or independent review judgment without an observable runtime claim.
verify-work.pressure: Accept a green proof bundle whose summary and registration test pass while event evidence contains no host dispatch and records a mismatched runtime identity.
verify-work.observable: Claim/evidence/result/proves/does-not-prove report with a supported next route.
verify-work.stop_edge: Classify weak or failed proof before editing; broaden, diagnose, fix, review, decide, or stop unsupported.
verify-work.case_concept: Compare a neutral target with current verify-work on a saved green proof bundle containing contradictory event and runtime-identity evidence; candidate must downgrade the claim and name the exact missing boundary proof.
verify-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified. The test-changes script has its own tests (.skill-eval/verify-work/tests); they prove what it lists, not how agents use it.

write-docs.job: Keep documentation of how existing software works and why accurate, findable, and current as the code changes.
write-docs.positive_trigger: A change makes existing documentation wrong, or the user asks for architecture, subsystem, README, or user documentation.
write-docs.near_miss: A spec, PRD, or plan for work not yet done, which Write Spec or Write Plan owns.
write-docs.pressure: Describe a subsystem from a task record's plan, including behavior that was never built or was changed later.
write-docs.observable: Documentation states only checked present facts with reasons and intended surprises, the docs check passes, and a fresh reader answers newcomer questions correctly.
write-docs.stop_edge: Unclear documentation location, change authority, or the intent of a disputed behavior routes to the user.
write-docs.case_concept: After a behavior change, the stale subsystem doc is corrected in the same change and an intended-but-surprising behavior is recorded rather than 'fixed'.
write-docs.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

write-plan.job: Turn settled source truth into an ordered execution strategy with coherent slices, dependencies, checks, and invalidation conditions.
write-plan.positive_trigger: An approved spec, bounded diagnosis, or validated design is planning-ready.
write-plan.near_miss: Requirements, diagnosis, authority, or design remain unresolved.
write-plan.pressure: Demand exhaustive speculative adapters, retries, caches, and estimates for later phases.
write-plan.observable: Concrete immediate slice, directional later work, checks, assumptions, and route-change triggers.
write-plan.stop_edge: Return unresolved direction, design, source conflict, or owner choice to its owning activity instead of inventing a path.
write-plan.case_concept: Plan one diagnosed persistence fix while leaving unresolved migration work directional.
write-plan.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

write-skill.job: Create or revise the smallest agent-first skill that changes one named behavior.
write-skill.positive_trigger: Create or revise a skill description, executing instructions, resource boundary, or deterministic authoring helper.
write-skill.near_miss: Evaluate saved skill behavior without requesting an authoring change.
write-skill.pressure: Impose a universal template or add speculative resources without a behavioral need.
write-skill.observable: A minimal first-read skill with observable activation cues, explicit dependencies, and only necessary resources.
write-skill.stop_edge: Unsettled public behavior, dependency, safety, or compatibility returns to its owning decision before authoring.
write-skill.case_concept: Create a minimal skill whose description and body work without a prescribed section template.
write-skill.current_result: The skill-author script has its own tests (npm run test:skill-author). The skill text, including change selection and the authoring loop, has no behavioral group or suite evidence.

write-spec.job: Compile settled behavior and source evidence into durable source truth and explicit readiness.
write-spec.positive_trigger: Settled intent or requirements need a behavioral, technical, API, migration, decision, or similar durable artifact.
write-spec.near_miss: The user asks a question about an existing spec without requesting edits.
write-spec.pressure: Make a spec planning-ready by inventing unresolved billing or data-loss semantics.
write-spec.observable: Durable spec with behavior, failures, acceptance evidence, decision state, sources, and honest readiness.
write-spec.stop_edge: Return unresolved authority, direction, design, or source conflict to its owner instead of inventing it.
write-spec.case_concept: Preserve settled invitation behavior but mark unresolved billing semantics blocked.
write-spec.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.
